scenario: The Codex companion rejects stale revisions and unauthorized writes, rotates session credentials, and marks disconnected work stale.
input: A stale revision, a read-only project, a rotated one-time token, a caller-supplied canonical origin, or a disconnect during an action.
visibleError: The protocol returns structured authorization, stale-session, or canvas_disconnected errors rather than applying the requested change.
recovery: A caller must reopen the current session and resubmit against the current revision after user-authorized write access exists.
sideEffects: Rejected or disconnected actions leave the canvas unchanged, and the companion never accepts a caller-controlled canonical origin.
